title: Normalized selected extension on the actual étale sequence site
statement:
For every scheme W, natural number l, inverse sequence B of finite rings annihilated by powers of l, and order embedding r of the natural numbers, there exists a CofinalExtension W B r in the sense of [def-pur-etale-system-cofinal-data]. Thus the ordinary selected left extension is adjoint to actual sequence-site restriction, and its ordinary and derived level comparisons have the specified unit and cochain normalizations. This is local to W and involves no compact-support functor.

Precise Lean statement (notation and universes as in the cited definition):
```lean
theorem etaleCofinalExtension_nonempty (W : Scheme.{u}) {l : ℕ}
    (B : Coefficients.{u} l) (r : ℕ ↪o ℕ) :
    Nonempty (CofinalExtension W B r)
```

proof.text: identify sequence-site modules with strict systems by the identity on every section and restriction, using strictSystemSequenceEquivalence. Transport the ordinary selected tensor extension and its adjunction across this equivalence. At m it is tensor extension from r(t(m)) applied to the component at t(m). The tensor-adjunction formula systemSelectedTranspose gives the recorded ordinaryLevel_unit, including t(r(i))=i. Resolve on the ringed sequence site by a K-flat complex with flat terms. Exact evaluation preserves these resolving complexes by systemSequenceEvaluation_preservesKFlat. The selected extension preserves quasi-isomorphisms between them, by componentwise scalar extension, so its normalized total left derived functor is adjoint to the exact localization of the actual sectionwise restriction. Transport the selected extension from systemLevelLeftExtensionTheory and use adjoint uniqueness with the ordinary unit normalization to identify its ordinary functor. Evaluation of this normalized derivation is the derived tensor formula; the universal cochain comparison gives level_normalization. For a K-flat complex without flat terms, resolve it again by such a flat-term complex. Its acyclic K-flat cone stays acyclic after scalar extension, so comparison with that resolution gives the same computation and representative normalization. These comparisons supply every field of CofinalExtension; no compact-support functor is involved.
